settings.auto_send_hint:
Flow: when a new meeting arrives via Fireflies it's first processed with AI (transcription, task and decision extraction). When processing finishes, the project admin gets a status email (including whether emails are missing on tasks or participants).

If this option is active, additionally, once the time set below has elapsed and provided all tasks have an owner email, emails and external tasks (Trello, Jira, ClickUp, Azure DevOps) are sent automatically without manual confirmation. If emails are missing at the timeout, the system does NOT send and notifies the admin to complete them.

settings.manual_mode_hint: Manual mode: if this option is inactive, emails and external tasks aren't sent until the curator dispatches them from the meeting detail. The meeting remains in the Meetings list waiting for action.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.s1_p1: At Acten we turn conversations into decisions, accountability, and deliverables. To do this, we process transcripts of your meetings and the associated metadata. This policy explains what data we collect, how we use it, who we share it with (almost no one), and what controls you have over it.
privacy.s1_p2_a: We are designed to comply with the EU
privacy.s1_p2_b: and equivalent laws across Latin America (Colombia's Law 1581, Mexico's LFPDPPP, Brazil's LGPD).
privacy.s2_li2_text_a: text transcripts generated by Fireflies or uploaded manually.
privacy.s2_li2_em: We do not retain the original audio
privacy.s2_li3_text: decisions, risks, agreements, tasks, and attendees extracted by AI.
privacy.s2_li4_text: API credentials for services you connect (Trello, Jira, ClickUp, etc.). We store them encrypted and only within your tenant.
privacy.s2_li5_text: action log (login, edit, dispatch) for SOC 2 compliance.
privacy.s2_li6_text: IP, user-agent, and access timestamps for security and incident response.
privacy.s3_p1: We only use your data to:
privacy.s3_li1: Generate the meeting minutes, tasks, and reports you contracted for.
privacy.s3_li2: Maintain the security of your account and the platform.
privacy.s3_p2_strong: We do NOT sell your data
privacy.s3_p2_text: , we do not use it to train public AI models, and we do not share it with advertisers.
privacy.s4_p1_a: Acten is multi-tenant: each customer company lives in an isolated space. At the database level every row carries a tenant identifier and every query filters by that identifier. One company can
privacy.s4_p1_b: see another's data, integrations, branding, or users. We verify this isolation with automated tests on every deployment.
privacy.s5_p1: Only with the providers strictly necessary to operate:
privacy.s5_li1_text: meeting transcriptions (if you connect your account).
privacy.s5_li2_text: AI processing of insights. Prompts are sent without additional personal metadata and the providers commit not to train on your data.
privacy.s5_li5_text: Trello, Jira, ClickUp, Slack, etc. — only when you dispatch manually.
privacy.s6_li1: Encryption in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest (AES-256).
privacy.s6_li3: HS256-signed JWT with quarterly SECRET_KEY rotation.
privacy.s6_li4: Global rate limiting (120 req/min per IP).
privacy.s6_li5: Unique per-tenant webhook tokens — verified with hmac.
privacy.s6_li6: Immutable audit log for critical actions (login, dispatch, delete).
privacy.s7_li1_text: export all your data as JSON from
privacy.s7_li2_text: edit your profile at any time.
privacy.s7_li3_text_b: We mark your account for purge and physically delete the data after 30 days.
privacy.s7_li4_text: the export includes sessions, action items, comments, and permissions in standard format.
privacy.s7_li5_text: contact us if you want us to stop processing a specific piece of data.
privacy.s8_li1: Meetings and action items: while your account is active.
privacy.s8_li4: Cancelled account: 30-day grace period, then physical purge.
privacy.s9_p1_strong2: We do not use third-party tracking cookies
privacy.s9_p1_c: (no Google Analytics, no Meta Pixel, no Hotjar). localStorage stores your JWT and tenant slug to remember your workspace.
privacy.s10_p1: If we update this policy we will notify you by email at least 14 days before material changes take effect.
privacy.s11_p1: To exercise your rights or for any privacy question:
privacy.s11_p2: You can also file a complaint with your local data protection authority.
